title: あめふり (Ame Furi — Rain Is Falling)
description: A child walks home in the rain, happy that their mother has come to meet them with a snake-eye umbrella (じゃのめ). Spotting a soaked child crying by a willow, they offer their own umbrella and share their mother's big parasol instead. Five warm verses full of rain onomatopoeia: 'ピッチピッチ チャップチャップ ランランラン'. First published November 1925. Lyrics: 北原白秋 (d.1942), music: 中山晋平 (d.1952) — both PD under 50-year rule.
